== frame up_shows_startup cursor=1,32
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo startup
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@1 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@1 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
== frame search_finds_later cursor=1,13
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
|search: later
|echo later_global
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@1 fg=default bg=default bold=1 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 search:
@2 fg=default bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=1 echo later_global
